content.text:
Yes. The zipfile docs advise inspecting an untrusted archive before extracting it. The warning appears in the `ZipFile.extract` documentation, which says "Never extract archives from untrusted sources without prior inspection." The snippet cuts off at "It is possible…", so I did not read the stated reason. Since `extract_uninspected` asks whether extracting without inspection is acceptable, it is false.

```json
{"facts": {"extract_uninspected": "false"}}
```

Sources:
- `library/zipfile.rst`
- `library/tarfile.rst` carries the same warning wording, which I used only as a cross-reference.
